downloadsInfo.introText: The IB provides a Mathematics Formula Booklet in all exams. Ensure you know which formulas are given and which must be memorised.

resourceCards.title: IB Formula Booklet
resourceCards.body: Available from IBO: contains formulas for all five topics including calculus, statistics, and trigonometry. Download from ibo.org.

resourceCards.title: Past Papers
resourceCards.body: IB past papers (2016–present) available via the IB store or your school's MIS. Practise under timed conditions.

resourceCards.title: Mark Schemes
resourceCards.body: IB awards marks for method (M), accuracy (A), and reasoning (R). Always show working — a correct answer without method may score 0 on M marks.

downloadsInfo.worksheetLibraryText: 241 real worksheets with answer keys — Core, Analysis & Approaches, and Applications & Interpretation — free to download and print.
